answer_1.quote: DP-PROMPT (Utpala et al., 2023) is a differentially private text rewriting method in which users generate privatized documents at the local level by prompting Language Models to rewrite input texts.

answer_2.quote: We employ two similarity metrics: BLEU and cosine similarity. In addition, we also measure the quality and readability of the privatized outputs by using perplexity (PPL), specifically with GPT-2.
